out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located to the right of the 3 vat sink was blocked by multiple piece of equipment such as bowls, a strainer and a whisk, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT HAND SINKS CANNOT BE BLOCKED AND MUST ALWAYS BE ACCESSIBLE FOR EMPLOYEES TO WASH TO PREVENT POTENTIAL CONTAMINATION. PIC REMOVED THE ITEMS FROM THE SINK.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT ALL HAND SINKS NEED TO HAVE A HAND WASHING SIGN. PIC SAID THEY WILL GET ONE BEFORE THE NEXT INSPECTION.
